capabilities.name: OpenAI-compatible HTTP/SSE serving
capabilities.summary: A chat-completions transport with streaming, bounded admission, cancellation, and evidence output.
capabilities.scope: The explicit temperature-zero continuous-batch-no-spec route is qualified only for the published source-locked Qwen3-32B-4bit workload. Scripted mode is transport-only, and no model weights are bundled.

capabilities.name: Exact continuous batching
capabilities.summary: Simultaneous dense-model streams can join, advance, cancel, and release reservations through one explicit no-spec route.
capabilities.scope: The measured policy is a dense-Qwen building block for the named paired workloads. It is not an automatic router, a sampled-generation route, or a general model-family default.

capabilities.name: Deterministic sampled-generation foundation
capabilities.summary: A dependency-free CPU oracle defines seeded temperature and top-p token selection with stable counter addressing.
capabilities.scope: Internal HarnessCore foundation only. It is not wired to HTTP requests, the serving scheduler, MLX arrays, models, tokenizers, or automatic entropy, and it makes no performance claim.

capabilities.name: Prompt-lookup decoding
capabilities.summary: Temperature-zero decoding can verify repeated context spans with byte-identical output on the measured repetition-heavy workload.
capabilities.scope: This is a dated solo-path result. Dynamic PLD is not the current production route and remains disabled inside shared continuous batches.

capabilities.name: Exact cache and lifecycle controls
capabilities.summary: Prefix/session-cache primitives, byte-denominated admission, cancellation, recovery, and reservation release are explicit contracts.
capabilities.scope: Source and regression contracts exist. This inventory makes no standalone cache-hit, speedup, or broad architecture claim.

capabilities.name: Quality and exactness measurement harness
capabilities.summary: Teacher-forced distribution drift, perplexity, tail behavior, exact replay, task checks, throughput, memory, and soak health share one evidence workflow.
capabilities.scope: Each measurement remains source-, model-, workload-, and instrument-scoped. A metric value is not a universal quality guarantee.

capabilities.name: Capacity and proof-control tools
capabilities.summary: Command-line planning, provenance, and fail-closed evidence controls make resource and identity assumptions inspectable.
capabilities.scope: Planning and comparison tools do not prove that a model fits every Mac, that an artifact is launchable, or that a runtime is contained.

performanceHighlights.label: Repetition-heavy solo PLD, 28.28 → 56.70 tok/s
performanceHighlights.workload: Preamble-then-echo; 256 generated tokens; three post-warmup runs; temperature zero
performanceHighlights.caveat: The 120-token streams were byte-identical, but dynamic PLD is not the current production route and remains disabled inside shared batches.

performanceHighlights.label: Aggregate C=2 service rate, 29.29 → 42.70 tok/s
performanceHighlights.workload: Paired simultaneous burst; one warmup dropped; three measured Release repetitions; temperature zero
performanceHighlights.caveat: The narrow dense-Qwen crossover starts at concurrency two for this workload. No automatic router, sampled route, or broad default was established.

performanceHighlights.label: HTTP/SSE service soak with 10,368 paired request/evidence rows
performanceHighlights.workload: C=4 continuous-batch-no-spec; 1,727 measured cycles; ordinary streams plus pre-body disconnects
performanceHighlights.caveat: This qualifies transport, cancellation, recovery, resources, and terminal evidence for the measured route. It is explicitly not a throughput result.
